TODAY’S HEADLINERS

DID YOU KNOW ABOUT BENGHAZI PARK?

36 animals.
Countless personalities.

Did you know BOSCO is home to 36 animals from four different continents? Meet the keepers and discover the personalities behind the paws, feathers and scales. Join an animal show or keeper-led feeding session to hear their stories.

Keeper-led viewing only. Stay behind barriers. Suggested sessions require Animal Care confirmation.

ATTRACTION NOTES

A helping hand

Ask a uniformed team member when you need directions or assistance. If the answer is unclear, we’ll help connect you to someone who knows.

Little explorers

Children attend activities with an accompanying adult. Keep your group together and ask the team promptly if you need help finding someone.

Plan with confidence

The timetable does not imply free entry or inclusion. Confirm attraction charges, eligibility and current access with the responsible team.
